title: Vijay's Cauvery talks plan with Karnataka sparks controversy in Tamil Nadu
summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister CM Vijay has proposed a plan to discuss the Cauvery water dispute with Karnataka. The proposal was met with criticism from opposition parties, who alleged that it would benefit Karnataka at the expense of Tamil Nadu. Meanwhile, some outlets highlighted concerns over infrastructure development in Tamil Nadu, citing airport and sewage issues. The government said that the talks were necessary to resolve the long-standing dispute. Police claimed that protests against the plan were being organized by opposition groups.
summary_points: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister CM Vijay proposed a plan to discuss the Cauvery water dispute with Karnataka.
The proposal was met with criticism from opposition parties, who alleged it would benefit Karnataka at Tamil Nadu's expense.
Outlets highlighted concerns over infrastructure development in Tamil Nadu, citing airport and sewage issues.
The government said that the talks were necessary to resolve the long-standing dispute.
Police claimed that protests against the plan were being organized by opposition groups.
title_hi: विजय के कावेरी बातचीत के योजना से तमिलनाडु में विवाद
summary_hi: तमिलनाडु मुख्यमंत्री विजय ने कावेरी जल विवाद के लिए एक योजना प्रस्तुत की, जिस पर विपक्षी दलों ने आलोचना की। उन्होंने यह तर्क दिया कि यह कर्नाटक के लाभ के लिए तमिलनाडु के हानि का कारण बनेगा। Meanwhile, कुछ सूत्रों ने तमिलनाडु में ढांचागत विकास पर चिंताओं को उजागर किया, जिसमें हवाई अड्डे और मल-इंधन प्रबंधन शामिल हैं। सरकार ने कहा कि बातचीत स्थायी विवाद को हल करने के लिए आवश्यक थी। पुलिस ने दावा किया कि विपक्षी दलों द्वारा योजना के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन किए जा रहे हैं।
